reason: PURE. What I noticed first was the little sachet that tears open with one hand, because I never touch the bottle on my kitchen counter and a sachet could live in my work bag. objection: $29.99 is double what I paid for a bottle that lasts 3 months, and this box is gone in 30 days. I would not reorder unless I actually keep using it.
would_change_my_mind: A first-box price around $19.99 or a flash-sale deal, or a bigger box for the same money.
